name: FADEO
description: FADEO is an AI TikTok trend video generator. Browse viral trend templates (dance, glow-up, bestie skits and more), upload a photo or short clip, and get a vertical 9:16 video with the same motion and timing starring you, your pet, or your friends. Templates use models like Seedance, Kling, MiniMax Hailuo or Wan. Pricing starts from about $2.45 per trend video via monthly plans or credit packs; failed generations are refunded.
